_about: Breaking API changes accepted on /api/v1 before the first external API release (D-095). Each entry is one exact problem reported by tooling.openapi_diff, with the decision and date that accepted it. When public_api_released is set to true (WP-041 or the first customer install, whichever comes first), this list must be empty: from then on a breaking change means /api/v2. CI fails otherwise.
